card.name: Alcoholic drink servings and limits
card.fires_on: The word drink, drinks, beer or glasses right after alcoholic or a count of servings, in text about how much alcohol is a standard serving or a daily limit.

modes.label: Drink after alcoholic
modes.description: The noun drink or drinks completing the phrase standard alcoholic drink.
modes.example: One standard alcoholic<< drink>> contains 14 grams of pure alcohol

modes.label: Beer or glasses in limits
modes.description: Beer or glasses of wine named in a daily-limit or equivalence statement.
modes.example: no more than two<< beers>> or glasses of wine for men and one

card.writes: The promoted tokens are about eating and drinking meals (dinner, enjoy, finish eating, a glass of), so the pole is a food-and-drink context signal, not a clear next-word push.
card.plain: It lights up on words for alcoholic drinks and servings when the text spells out how much a standard drink is or how many are allowed.
